title: The Completionist Pack
description: A Modpack to make your 100% experience better
body:
# The Completionist Pack

A modpack built for players who want to collect everything, complete every advancement, and experience Minecraft to its fullest.

***

## Main Features

### Collect Everything
Track every block, item, entity, biome, structure, effect, and enchantment you've collected — all in one animated gallery. Press `\` to open (configurable in the Keybind settings), see what you've found, see what you haven't, and watch your progress fill in.


### BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack
Massively expands the vanilla advancement system with hundreds of new challenges across every aspect of the game. From mining to combat to exploration — there's always something new to complete. You can find it in the Advancements Menu.

***

### Also Includes
- Performance mods for a smooth experience
- Quality of life improvements
- Visual enhancements
- A minimap and world map
- Grave mod so you never lose your items on death

## Environment
This Modpack is meant to be played in Singleplayer. You could play it on a Server but i don't recommend it.
